definition: A 35B mixture-of-experts Qwen3.6 model with about 3B active parameters, used across 4 sources as a recent efficient open backbone. Its most informative archived datum is an infrastructure one: in a mixed rollout-serving study its tool-interaction gap is 22.7 percent of agent task time against 6.6 for a comparison model, which is why model inference time understates cache residency and why residency-aware accounting is worth a further 9.7 percent throughput on it. It also appears as a poisoning subject, in a cultural-knowledge audit, and in test-time-scaling reproducibility work.

evidence.note: Builds a parallel entity grid of 27 folk-narrative motifs across 10 cultures and instruments 18 models with probing, logit lens, activation patching and generation, finding that the residual stream separates cultures cleanly in every model while the readout collapses onto Greco-Roman defaults — so the failure is at the decoder, not the encoder.
evidence.title: Cultural Awareness is Represented but Not Decoded: Tracing Mythological Knowledge across 18 Open-Source LLMs

evidence.note: Shows that supervised fine-tuning can install a triggered backdoor whose visible reasoning stays clean, correct and topically benign while the final answer is attacker-chosen — leaving CoT-only monitors at chance (AUC 0.44-0.55) and recovering detection only when the monitor is shown the answer alongside the trace (0.76-1.00).
evidence.title: Evading Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Through Model Poisoning

evidence.note: Formalizes test-time scaling as budgeted inference over a model's implicit prefix tree, separates three structurally different regimes that a single scalar budget conflates, specifies what a reproducible inference protocol must declare, and releases 1.9 million traces — with the empirical section showing a selection score that makes accuracy fall from 75.56% to 65.83% as the candidate bank grows.
evidence.title: Test-Time Scaling in Reasoning LLMs: Inference Regimes, Evaluation, and Reproducibility

evidence.note: A routing-layer admission policy for RL post-training that treats admitting a rollout session as a commitment of KV-cache capacity, allocates protected capacity per workload class by footprint and observed residency time, and leaves the workload mixture itself under the trainer's control.
evidence.title: Scheduling Mixed RL Rollouts Beyond Prefix Locality

name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B
